dashboard.welcome_back_active: Continue your writing journey or explore other tools.
dashboard.welcome_back_inactive: Select a story or create a new one to get started!
dashboard.no_story_selected_desc: Please select an existing story or create a new one to begin working. Most features are disabled until a story is active.
dashboard.how_to_use_desc: Here's a quick guide to get you started.
dashboard.how_to_use_feature_1_desc: A clean space to write your masterpiece.
dashboard.how_to_use_feature_2_desc: Manage multiple stories, each with its own documents, characters, and outlines.
dashboard.how_to_use_feature_3_desc: Create detailed character profiles and sheets.
dashboard.how_to_use_feature_4_desc: Structure your narrative with a drag-and-drop outliner.
dashboard.how_to_use_feature_5_desc: Get writing prompts, feedback, and analysis (opt-in required in Settings).
dashboard.how_to_use_beta_desc: This is a preliminary release. Features may change and unexpected issues may occur. Your feedback is greatly appreciated!
dashboard.how_to_use_storage_title: Important: How Your Data is Saved
dashboard.how_to_use_storage_desc_1: By default, all your writing data (stories, characters, etc.) is stored **locally in your web browser only**. This means if you clear your browser's data, use a different browser, or switch devices, your work will be lost.
dashboard.how_to_use_storage_desc_2: To prevent data loss, please connect to Google Drive in the sidebar or **always save a backup copy** of your work elsewhere using the export features.

quick_actions.ai_tools_desc: Explore creative writing prompts and analysis.

dashboard.writing_streak_desc: Keep your momentum going! Streak is per story.
dashboard.select_story_for_streak: Select a story to see its streak.
dashboard.word_goal_desc: Set and track your daily/weekly targets. (View in Analytics)

ai.title: AI Features
ai.description: Enable or disable AI-powered writing assistance tools.
ai.enable_desc: Allow the app to send selected text to third-party services for analysis and suggestions.
ai.privacy_desc: By enabling AI features, you acknowledge that the text you submit for analysis will be sent to external AI models for processing. OpenWritingKit does not store this text, and **your data is not used for training the AI models.** You can disable this feature at any time.
ai.transparency_desc: Our AI features are powered by Google's Gemini models. For more information on how data is handled, please review the relevant privacy policies.
